supporting_evidence.extracted_text:
Event Report
C-START — Industry Interaction Programme
On the 18th of July 2026, the Computer Science department organized C-START, an industry
interaction programme aimed at connecting final-year and third-year students with the software
industry. The event was held at the department seminar hall from 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM.
Chief Guest: Mr. Rajesh Pillai, Chief Technology Officer, Nimbus Technologies. Mr. Pillai delivered the
keynote address titled 'What the Industry Really Wants from CS Graduates', followed by a panel
discussion with representatives from two additional companies, Vertex Software and BlueLeaf
Systems.
A total of 45 students from the third and fourth year batches participated. The programme concluded
with a networking session where students interacted directly with industry representatives. Feedback
collected from participants was overwhelmingly positive, with 92% rating the event as 'very useful' for
career preparation.
This is the second edition of C-START, following the inaugural programme held in December 2025. The
department plans to conduct C-START as a recurring annual event.
Report prepared by: Prof. Sarah Thomas, Event Coordinator
Report submitted: 22 July 2026

Computer Science Department
Minutes of Department Meeting
Meeting Date: 18/07/2026
Time: 3:00 PM - 4:30 PM
Venue: HOD Chamber
Attendees: Dr. Reena Nair (HOD), Prof. Sarah Thomas, Prof. Arun Kumar, Prof. Divya Menon, Prof.
George Mathew
Agenda
1. Review of C-START industry interaction programme conducted on 18 July 2026
2. Faculty development programme (FDP) planning for August
3. Lab equipment procurement status update
4. Feedback from third-year student representatives
Discussion
The department successfully conducted the C-START industry interaction programme on 18 July 2026
in the seminar hall, in collaboration with three local software companies. Prof. Sarah Thomas reported
that 45 third-year students attended, and feedback forms indicated high satisfaction with the panel
discussion format. Mr. Rajesh Pillai, CTO of Nimbus Technologies, delivered the keynote address on
industry expectations from CS graduates.
Prof. Arun Kumar raised the topic of the upcoming Faculty Development Programme, proposing the
week of 10 August 2026. The committee agreed to finalize the schedule at the next meeting on 25 July
2026.
Dr. Nair informed the committee that lab equipment procurement (12 new workstations) is pending final
budget approval from the college administration, expected by end of month.
